$ cat <scratch>/hooks-v/pre-commit
#!/bin/sh
# File generated by prek: https://github.com/j178/prek
# ID: 182c10f181da4464a3eec51b83331688

HERE="/Users/brian.kwon/repos/4thandgoal/.git/hooks"
PREK="/opt/homebrew/bin/prek"

# Check if the full path to prek is executable, otherwise fallback to PATH
if [ ! -x "$PREK" ]; then
    PREK="prek"
fi

exec "$PREK" -c <scratch>/prek-verbose.yaml hook-impl --hook-dir "$HERE" --script-version 4 --hook-type=pre-commit -- "$@"
